mappings.rationale: The original R-LCS-ST registration names its private capture. Existing R-PD-RM21 records the official STMicroelectronics location for the identical documented capture SHA-256. Render that already documented public location without distributing the capture or replacing either inspected resource record.
mappings.limits: Publication-location projection only. Original registration, identity, locators, inspection scope, capture metadata and execution receipts remain unchanged. No new passage inspection, current remote byte equality, redistribution permission, physical observation or independent assessment is claimed.
